create_ase_read_dataset: create an AseReadDataset to load ASE-readable files from a directory using a glob pattern
create_ase_read_multi_dataset: create an AseReadMultiStructureDataset to read multiple structures from trajectory files with an index file
create_ase_db_dataset: create an AseDBDataset to connect to one or more ASE databases and load atomic structures
apply_one_tags_transform: apply the apply_one_tags function to set default tags of 1 on an ASE atoms object
connect_ase_db: connect to an ASE database using AseDBDataset.connect_db with optional readonly and lock file settings
